# Button

A link styled as the site’s pill button.

Include `gg/button.html` · Figma: Button · Formats: web, flyer, social · Decisions: D-030, D-033

The contract is `_data/components/button.yml` (COMP-002). Sources are explained in [Components](../../brand/system/components.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | yes |  | request | A verb first, sentence case, no exclamation mark (MECH-012). |
| `href` | url | yes |  | request |  |
| `style` | enum: default, bright | no | default | fixed | bright on dark surfaces (D-030). |
